review_evidence: README identifies hex-dev as the development monorepo for verified computational algebra in Lean and points to its specification, execution plan, library DAG, and released aggregate.

The hydrated snapshot contains 965 Lean files; a proposition scan finds thousands of theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across the split Hex libraries, conformance material, manual/examples, and supporting developments.

Generated, benchmark, conformance, test, documentation-source, and release-layout roles cannot be excluded by path alone because they can contain unique declarations, specifications, examples, and search terminology; no unit-wide lossless hard exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the verified-computational-algebra Hex development monorepo in full for this review unit.
